about: Shared test sentences for rule-based extraction (spec/SPEC.md, 'Extraction'). expect holds only what the sentence states: no id, no device GPS (the app adds both). priority is set only when the sentence asks for a priority different from the type default. Lists are in bit order. unsupported=true means the extractor must not invent fields and should offer the text fallback (expect = the text message, cut to 180 bytes).

cases.name: de-pitch
cases.text: Kind gefunden, ansprechbar, stark unterkühlt, Knöchel verletzt. Wir brauchen eine Trage und zwei Leute.
cases.notes: The demo sentence. 'Knöchel verletzt' counts as fracture (suspected).

cases.name: de-unconscious-breathing
cases.text: Person gefunden, bewusstlos, atmet aber. Brauchen Sauerstoff und 2 Helfer.

cases.name: de-awake-but-confused
cases.text: Vermisste Frau gefunden, wach aber verwirrt, kann nicht laufen
cases.notes: 'verwirrt' is more specific than 'wach' and wins. 'kann nicht laufen' must not also give 'walks'.

cases.name: de-not-breathing-critical
cases.text: Mann gefunden, nicht ansprechbar, atmet nicht! Sofort Notarzt und Defi!
cases.notes: 'nicht ansprechbar' is unconscious, not conscious. 'atmet nicht' is none, not normal.

cases.name: de-typos-walks
cases.text: habe den jungen gefunen, gehts ihm gut, kann selbst laufen
cases.notes: Typo 'gefunen'. 'gehts ihm gut' sets nothing.

cases.name: de-two-hikers

cases.notes: Same state for both, so one found message with count 2 is fine.
